content:
sophia: Heads-up — noticed a couple small UX regressions in the console: icon-only buttons in the table action row feel too tight on hover, modal close button's hit area got smaller in the latest patch, and toasts are stacking under the top nav on mobile. Screenshot/GIF attached: https://img.redwood.dev/console-ux-issue.gif. Anyone seen this?
ajay: thanks — which branch? can you paste the screenshot link here (can't open from mobile otherwise)?
sophia: branch feat/ui-tokens. screenshot above is the GIF; still frames: https://img.redwood.dev/console-button-gap.png. quick note: spacing token used looks like --space-xs in the CSS.
maria: looks like the table action row uses --space-xs (4px) around icon-only buttons but other places use --space-2 (8px). feels inconsistent. also one of the icon buttons doesn't have aria-label — tooltip covers it but screen reader won't.
leo: confirmed — modal close was unintentionally tightened by a negative margin in the modal-wrapper change. current computed size ~28x28. I can revert that margin.
kate: toast stacking: on small screens the toast z-index is 9000, header is 10000, so toasts slip behind the header when header uses transform. quick workaround is set toast z-index > header or remove transform on header. but removal has layout implications.
samir: we should not hardcode numbers. propose tokens: z-header, z-modal, z-toast, and document ordering. then update CSS to reference tokens.
design-bot: Reminder: design tokens were last updated in main at 1777999900. Run `yarn tokens:build` after changes to regenerate CSS variables.
ajay: sophia — can you confirm which icon-only buttons lack aria-label so I can create the a11y task?
sophia: the row actions: kebab (more) and the inline run icon. "More" currently relies on tooltip only; when tooltip not visible there's no accessible name. I'll add aria-label and adjust spacing to --space-2 (8px).
maria: also let's ensure touch targets meet minimum 44x44 for mobile per WCAG. modal close should be bumped.
leo: will update modal CSS to ensure min-width/min-height 44px. plan to add `min-width:44px; min-height:44px; padding:6px;` on .modal-close in the PR. will attach before/after screenshots.
kate: i'll open a short RFC for z-index tokens with ordering table + recommended values (suggestion: z-header:1000, z-modal:1100, z-toast:1200) so it's consistent across teams.
samir: also add a visual-regression test that renders header + toasts + modal to catch stacking issues.
sophia: checklist for follow-up: 1) add aria-labels + spacing token change; 2) modal close hit target -> 44px; 3) add z-index tokens and update toasts/header to use them; 4) run tokens build and publish; 5) add visual/e2e test. I'll create tasks in the tracker and assign.
ajay: :eyes: low-risk. can we target a patch release today if PRs are small?
design-bot: ci/build: feat/ui-tokens branch built and deployed to staging at 1778000100 (build #452). Visual snapshots available at https://staging.redwood.dev/snapshots/452.
sophia: perfect. thanks all — I'll start the PRs and tag folks for review. :thumbsup:
